Subject: Interest in Redwood Inference (Marketplace listing) — quick intro & trial

Hi Vanessa,

Saw Redwood on the cloud marketplace and I wanted to reach out — we're evaluating inference platforms for a pilot (real-time chat + embeddings) and your listing looked promising. A few context points: CloudTile is building a conversational ops assistant for enterprise support (multi-tenant, PCI-adjacent data). We've already spun up a couple of self-serve instances via the marketplace and did some basic tests.

Would love a short intro + demo (30–40 mins) to:
- see latency characteristics for multi-tenant workloads
- understand deployment options (hosted vs. private)
- walk through pricing and reserved capacity benefits

I'm based in PST and prefer late-mornings on weekdays. I attached a short use-case summary. Also looping procurement (procurement@cloudtile.io) — they may want to start the procurement conversation after the demo.

Thanks,
Priya Reddy
Head of Platform
CloudTile
